_comment: Editorial content for FECM. Every fact here is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached. A modaraba is a listed Islamic financing vehicle, so products is left empty rather than filled with guessed 'products'.
description: First Elite Capital Modaraba is a perpetual, multi-purpose modaraba — a listed Islamic financing vehicle formed under the Modaraba Companies and Modaraba (Floatation and Control) Ordinance, 1980 — managed by Crescent Modaraba Management Company Limited. Floated in September 1991, it is engaged in ijarah, musharakah and murabahah financing and in investment in marketable securities. Its registered office is in Lahore.
headOffice: 182-A, Garden Block, New Garden Town, Lahore, Pakistan
sourceNote: Modaraba website (fecm.com.pk: about us, corporate information), read 2026-10-17. The only telephone published on the pages read belongs to the share registrar, and the management company's chairman and chief executive are listed without a clear one-to-one mapping, so phone and ceo are left empty.
